commentary_title: Uptick in Eastbound tonnage demand to support rates
commentary_summary: It was a quiet week for the crude tanker market as market sentiments weakened and excess tonnage supply, especially in the Middle East, softened rates. However, the VLCC tonne-miles index improved, ending the week at 100.7 points owing to increased movement towards the East. | Despite spot rates declining on ex-MEG, rates towards China showed an uptick last week, which is likely to result in a higher utilisation and increased %laden vessels in the East next week.
